body.p: Claims 1-15 are pending in the application. The Office Action asserts the pending claims are subject to restriction requirement under 35 U.S.C. § 121 as being drawn to patentably distinct groups, and, therefore, require election of one of the following groups of claims:
Group I. Claims 1-11, drawn to an aircraft light, classified in B 64 D4 7 /06
Group II. Claims 12-15, drawn to method of manufacturing an aircraft light,

Applicant hereby elects Group I, including claims 1-11, without traverse, drawn to an automatic drain system. Claims 12-15 are withdrawn. Applicant reserves the right to pursue prosecution of unelected claims and to request rejoinder in the present application upon allowance of the elected claims. This election is made without waiver, estoppel, and without prejudice to the filing of one or more related applications directed to the unelected group(s).

In view of the above remarks and amendments, Applicant respectfully submits that all pending claims are in condition for allowance. The Examiner is invited to telephone the undersigned at the Examiner's convenience, if doing so will further prosecution of the subject application. The Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge any fees that may be required or credit any overpayment to Deposit Account No. 192814. This statement does NOT authorize charge of the issue fee.
